c_attn, c_proj → W_qkv, W_o · mlp → W_1, W_2
Crucial Layout Difference: TensorFlow Conv1D (in, out) vs PyTorch Linear (out, in)
PyTorch nn.Linear stores weight as (out, in) → MUST transpose 2D Conv1D weights (W.T)!
Flax nnx.Linear stores kernel as (in, out) → copies Conv1D weights directly without transpose.
